title_sq: Super apartament 1+1 per shitje te Mine Peza
description_sq:

Per me teper informacion , me kontaktoni!
title_en: Super apartment 1+1 for sale in Mine Peza
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza, very close to the center of Tirana! The apartment has a total area = 57 m2, while the net area = 50 m2. It is located on the 3rd floor of a building built in 2005, without an elevator. (It has been agreed to settle soon.) The apartment has a very functional organization and a very favorable South orientation. The investment made in the apartment is worth noting, since the highest quality and most prestigious materials in the market were used: - New electrical and plumbing installations - Refinishing done with an architect, using every space efficiently - Thermal duralumin windows - Pajtoni Ceramica tiles For more information, contact me!
